description: ANP fuel price survey. Section 1: pipeline health (tasks, source files control, Airflow, logs). Section 2: statistical pre-assessment of every survey batch (file x collection month) from anp_bronze.batch_profile.

target.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, coalesce(finished_at, now()) AS timeend, 'anp ' || status AS text, status AS tags FROM audit.pipeline_run WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND $__timeFilter(started_at)

targets.rawSql: SELECT status FROM audit.pipeline_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id'
SELECT extract(epoch FROM coalesce(finished_at, now()) - started_at) FROM audit.pipeline_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id'
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (task_id) status FROM audit.task_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY task_id, attempt DESC) t WHERE status = 'FAILED'
SELECT coalesce(sum(files_ok), 0) FROM audit.task_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND task_id = 'anp02_download'
SELECT coalesce(sum(bytes_out), 0) FROM audit.task_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND task_id = 'anp02_download'
SELECT coalesce(sum(rows_out), 0) FROM audit.task_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND layer = 'bronze'
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'BLOCK') AS block, count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'WARN') AS warn FROM audit.dq_event WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND status = 'FAIL'
SELECT coalesce(sum(rows_rejected), 0) FROM audit.task_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id'

SELECT task_id, attempt, status, started_at, round(duration_s) AS duration_s, files_total, files_ok, files_failed, files_skipped, rows_in, rows_out, rows_rejected, bytes_out, warn_count, block_count, airflow_task_id, error_class, left(error_message, 200) AS error FROM audit.task_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY started_at

SELECT task_id || CASE WHEN attempt > 1 THEN ' #' || attempt ELSE '' END AS task, round(coalesce(duration_s, extract(epoch FROM now() - started_at))) AS seconds FROM audit.task_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY started_at
SELECT created_at, task_id, check_name, severity, status, observed, threshold, left(message, 300) AS message FROM audit.dq_event WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY (status = 'FAIL') DESC, created_at
SELECT component, status, latency_ms, detail::text AS detail FROM audit.health_check WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY component

panels.title: Trace of the run (audit SQL, works without Tempo)
panels.description: Same ids as the Tempo trace (md5(run_id)); with Tempo running, Explore → Tempo → {resource.service.name="lambda-anp"} shows the full spans.

targets.rawSql: SELECT "traceID", "spanID", "parentSpanID", "operationName", "serviceName", "startTime", duration FROM audit.v_trace_spans WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY "startTime"
SELECT count(*) FROM ctrl.source_file WHERE pipeline = 'anp'
SELECT count(*) FROM ctrl.source_file WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND download_status = 'DOWNLOADED'
SELECT count(*) FROM ctrl.source_file WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND bronze_status = 'LOADED'
SELECT count(*) FROM ctrl.source_file WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND ((listed AND download_status = 'PENDING') OR (download_status = 'DOWNLOADED' AND bronze_status = 'PENDING'))
SELECT count(*) FROM ctrl.source_file WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND (download_status IN ('FAILED', 'MISSING_AT_SOURCE') OR bronze_status = 'FAILED')
SELECT coalesce(sum(local_bytes), 0) FROM ctrl.source_file WHERE pipeline = 'anp'

SELECT source_kind, product_group, download_status, bronze_status, count(*) AS files, sum(local_bytes) AS bytes, sum(bronze_rows) AS rows, sum(bronze_quarantined) AS quarantined, min(period_start) AS from_period, max(period_end) AS to_period, max(loaded_at) AS last_load FROM ctrl.source_file WHERE pipeline = 'anp' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4

panels.title: Files needing attention
panels.description: Failed or missing downloads/loads, files no longer linked from the page, pending ones and duplicates.

targets.rawSql: SELECT file_key, download_status, bronze_status, listed, download_attempts, left(last_error, 200) AS last_error, url, updated_at FROM ctrl.source_file WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND (download_status IN ('FAILED', 'MISSING_AT_SOURCE') OR bronze_status = 'FAILED' OR NOT listed OR (listed AND download_status = 'PENDING') OR duplicate_of IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1d'), event AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM ctrl.source_file_event WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT created_at, file_key, event, version, bytes, rows, left(detail::text, 300) AS detail, run_id FROM ctrl.source_file_event WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT run_id, state, run_type, queued_at, start_date, end_date, round(extract(epoch FROM coalesce(end_date, now()) - start_date)) AS duration_s, conf::text AS conf FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = 'anp_pipeline' ORDER BY coalesce(start_date, queued_at) DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Task instances of the latest Airflow run

targets.rawSql: SELECT task_id, state, try_number, start_date, end_date, round(duration::numeric) AS duration_s, hostname FROM task_instance WHERE dag_id = 'anp_pipeline' AND run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = 'anp_pipeline' ORDER BY coalesce(start_date, queued_at) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY start_date NULLS LAST

panels.title: Airflow task log lines by level
Airflow task logs (anp_pipeline)
panels.description: Exactly what the Airflow UI shows per task attempt (stdout of the scripts included).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts, level, task_id, event, left(message, 300) AS message FROM audit.log_event WHERE pipeline = 'anp' AND level IN ('WARNING', 'ERROR', 'CRITICAL') AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 300

panels.title: 2 · Survey batches (lotes de pesquisa) — statistical pre-assessment

options.content:
A **survey batch** (*lote de pesquisa*) is one source file × one collection month
(`YYYY-MM` of *data da coleta*): a monthly file is one batch, a semester file six, a weekly file one or two.
Statistics are computed at bronze load time (`anp_bronze.batch_profile`, raw text parsed only here: prices with a
decimal comma, dates `dd/mm/yyyy`). Since 2023 the same month exists in a semester, a monthly and weekly files:
compare them here; silver keeps one (semestral > mensal > semanal). **GLP** is priced per 13 kg bottle, the others
per litre (GNV per m³). Filter by *File kind* and *Product* at the top.

panels.title: Batch matrix — average sale price per product, stations (CNPJ) and brands per batch
panels.description: One row per survey batch. Price columns = average valor_de_venda of the product in the batch (empty = product not surveyed in that file). stations = distinct CNPJ surveyed, brands = distinct bandeiras, price_missing = rows without a parseable price.

targets.rawSql: SELECT batch, file_key, source_kind, rows, stations, brands, cities, ufs, gasolina, gasolina_aditivada, etanol, diesel, diesel_s10, diesel_s50, gnv, glp, other_product_rows, price_missing FROM anp_bronze.v_batch_matrix WHERE source_kind IN (${kind:singlequote}) ORDER BY batch_month DESC, CASE source_kind WHEN 'semestral' THEN 1 WHEN 'mensal' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, file_key
SELECT count(*) FROM anp_bronze.v_batch_matrix WHERE source_kind IN (${kind:singlequote})
SELECT count(DISTINCT batch_month) FROM anp_bronze.batch_profile WHERE batch_month > 0 AND source_kind IN (${kind:singlequote})
SELECT min(batch) || ' → ' || max(batch) FROM anp_bronze.v_batch_matrix WHERE batch_month > 0 AND source_kind IN (${kind:singlequote})
SELECT coalesce(sum(price_missing), 0) FROM anp_bronze.batch_profile WHERE produto = '*' AND source_kind IN (${kind:singlequote})

panels.title: Average sale price per month — fuels (R$/l, GNV R$/m³)
panels.description: One point per month and product; when several files cover a month the most consolidated source wins (semestral > mensal > semanal).

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, produto AS metric, price_avg AS value FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (batch_month, produto) to_date(batch_month::text, 'YYYYMM')::timestamp AS time, batch_month, produto, price_avg FROM anp_bronze.batch_profile WHERE batch_month > 0 AND source_kind IN (${kind:singlequote}) AND produto IN (${product:singlequote}) ORDER BY batch_month, produto, CASE source_kind WHEN 'semestral' THEN 1 WHEN 'mensal' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, profiled_at DESC) t ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Average GLP P13 price per month (R$/13 kg)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, produto AS metric, price_avg AS value FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (batch_month, produto) to_date(batch_month::text, 'YYYYMM')::timestamp AS time, batch_month, produto, price_avg FROM anp_bronze.batch_profile WHERE batch_month > 0 AND source_kind IN (${kind:singlequote}) AND produto = 'GLP' ORDER BY batch_month, produto, CASE source_kind WHEN 'semestral' THEN 1 WHEN 'mensal' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, profiled_at DESC) t ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Stations surveyed (distinct CNPJ) per batch
panels.description: Per file family: overlapping files of the same month should survey a similar number of stations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_date(batch_month::text, 'YYYYMM')::timestamp AS time, source_kind || ' ' || product_group AS metric, stations AS value FROM anp_bronze.batch_profile WHERE produto = '*' AND batch_month > 0 AND source_kind IN (${kind:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_date(batch_month::text, 'YYYYMM')::timestamp AS time, source_kind || ' ' || product_group AS metric, brands AS value FROM anp_bronze.batch_profile WHERE produto = '*' AND batch_month > 0 AND source_kind IN (${kind:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_date(batch_month::text, 'YYYYMM')::timestamp AS time, source_kind || ' ' || product_group AS metric, rows AS value FROM anp_bronze.batch_profile WHERE produto = '*' AND batch_month > 0 AND source_kind IN (${kind:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_date(batch_month::text, 'YYYYMM')::timestamp AS time, source_kind || ' ' || product_group || ' cities' AS metric, cities AS value FROM anp_bronze.batch_profile WHERE produto = '*' AND batch_month > 0 AND source_kind IN (${kind:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_date(batch_month::text, 'YYYYMM')::timestamp AS time, source_kind || ' ' || product_group || ' UFs' AS metric, ufs AS value FROM anp_bronze.batch_profile WHERE produto = '*' AND batch_month > 0 AND source_kind IN (${kind:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Price dispersion per batch and product
panels.description: min / median / average / max sale price, standard deviation and coefficient of variation (cv %) of every product in every batch. A cv far from its neighbours or min/max outliers point to typing errors at the source.

targets.rawSql: SELECT left(batch_month::text, 4) || '-' || right(batch_month::text, 2) AS batch, file_key, produto, rows, stations, price_min, price_p50, price_avg, price_max, price_stddev, round(100 * price_stddev / nullif(price_avg, 0), 1) AS cv_pct, price_missing, buy_price_avg FROM anp_bronze.batch_profile WHERE produto <> '*' AND batch_month > 0 AND source_kind IN (${kind:singlequote}) AND produto IN (${product:singlequote}, 'GLP') ORDER BY batch_month DESC, produto, CASE source_kind WHEN 'semestral' THEN 1 WHEN 'mensal' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

panels.title: Data quality per file
panels.description: Quarantined records (wrong field count), rows whose date did not parse (batch 'no date'), rows without a price, rows of products outside the matrix columns.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.file_key, s.source_kind, s.bronze_rows AS rows, s.bronze_quarantined AS quarantined, p.batches, p.no_date_rows, p.price_missing, p.other_product_rows, s.version, s.loaded_at FROM ctrl.source_file s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT file_key, count(*) FILTER (WHERE batch_month > 0) AS batches, coalesce(sum(rows) FILTER (WHERE batch_month = 0), 0) AS no_date_rows, sum(price_missing) AS price_missing, sum(other_product_rows) AS other_product_rows FROM anp_bronze.v_batch_matrix GROUP BY file_key) p ON p.file_key = s.file_key WHERE s.pipeline = 'anp' AND s.bronze_status = 'LOADED' AND s.source_kind IN (${kind:singlequote}) ORDER BY (coalesce(s.bronze_quarantined, 0) + coalesce(p.no_date_rows, 0) + coalesce(p.price_missing, 0)) DESC, s.file_key
